response.sql: WITH state_counts AS (SELECT c.state_county_province, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM Customers AS c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Accounts AS a WHERE a.customer_id = c.customer_id) GROUP BY c.state_county_province), state_shares AS (SELECT customer_count, 1.0 * customer_count / SUM(customer_count) OVER () AS share FROM state_counts), compared AS (SELECT customer_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM state_shares) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(customer_count), 0) AS combined_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess FROM compared WHERE share > average_share;
